title: •Corporal Derdram
caption: •Corporal Derdram (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While at an _Executor_ site, may use 1 Force to place a just lost non-unique smuggler (and all copies of that card in opponent’s Lost Pile) out of play. At same non-docking bay site, opponent may not deploy Jar Jar or spies.
lore: Member of Imperial Intelligence, Internal Security division. Assigned by IntSec to _Executor_. Responsible for physical safety of Imperial personnel against Rebel saboteurs.
